Tesla) is a member of the UFS and Task Force G.

She used to be Corporal Esposito until she was turned into a Cyborg.




Personality
Tesla has been brainwashed to be a cold and almost emotionless killing machine. Under her brainwashing, she is a sympathetic, compassionate and friendly women.

Appearance
She has dark skin, green eyes and long black hair. There is a tear-like scar under the left eye, all her limbs are removed and were exchanged for a transparent superconductor in which lightning constantly flows.

History
Background
Currently one of the strongest 10 Cyborg Soldiers of Task Force G, as part of the KINGS Squad.

She used to be a female soldier named Corporal Esposito, who is believed to have died during in Afghanistan. She was a brave and compassionate woman, but as a result of brainwashing by the G organization, she became a ruthless and loyal fighting machine. One of the first cyborgs to be created, she was subjected to numerous cruel experiments, and finally became KINGS-3 through one of “G's” most powerful inventions, the super-electromagnetic arm and leg. It is said that her genitalia and other parts were left behind for reproductive experiments, but the authorities deny this. Her super-electromagnetic arms and legs are formed by strong magnetic flux, so to speak, like electric limbs. The magnetic force attracts metal and makes it into giant limbs, which can then be used to carry out transformative physical attacks. She can also stop any electronic control system with an EMP (electromagnetic wave) attack called a "Tesla Attack". Furthermore, when she receives the organization's self-destruct command, she can detonate herself as an EMP bomb, which is said to be powerful enough to bring a major city to a standstill.

Timeline TABA
Was sent after Fuuma Kotaro after he killed Fuuma Danjo of "G". Kotaro was at the time under the protection of the Taimanin on one of their beaches, but Tesla was able to find him fast and started to chase him. Unable to fight her, Kotaro used the full power of his Evil Eye for the first time and used the body of a civilian beach goer "Katsuragi Maki" to hide. The evil eye absorbing Mari and turning him into her, a transformation much above basic illusion. Tesla saw the blood trail end on the girl but could not find Kotaro, assuming she was tricked by the trail, she assumed Kotaro moved another way and chased elsewhere.


Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Arms and Legs

Superconductor Limbs: Her limbs are filled with electricity in a strong magnetic field, and each part including the body is floating in the air. Physical attacks slip through, and touching or holding her can result in death.
Self-Destruct Device: Can explode parts of her body.
Media
Taimanin Asagi Battle Arena
Trivia
She is a quadruple amputee.
Her name is a based of Nikola Tesla and his research into electrical engineering
More information, given in TABA Artbook 7.
